items.title: Six weeks to go: Have you registered for the BAPEN Annual Conference 2026?
items.summary: With just six weeks until the BAPEN Annual Conference 2026, now is the ideal time to secure your place and make any necessary arrangements for study leave and attendance.

items.title: Last chance to submit Adult Intestinal Failure Registry Q2 2026 data
items.summary: The reporting period for collection of Adult Intestinal Failure Registry data for Q2 2026, covering 1st July to 30th September 2026, will close at midnight on Friday 16th October 2026.

items.title: BAPEN Position Statement on The Role Nutritional Support in the Management of Disease-Related malnutrition
items.summary: This position statement explores the role of nutritional support in the management of disease-related malnutrition, highlighting the importance of early identification and appropriate, evidence-based intervention.

items.title: Become a Mentor
items.summary: BAPEN runs a mentoring programme which is free for its members. You can either join as a mentor to help someone or as a mentee to get support and guidance in your career journey. Mentoring is an excellent opportunity to develop leadership, communication skills and build a professional network.

items.title: BACME ME/CFS Tube Feeding Survey Report
items.summary: The British Association of Clinicians in ME/CFS (BACME) Tube Feeding Survey Report has now been published on the BACME website.

items.title: BAPEN Medical are looking to broaden their membership
items.summary: Are you a doctor or surgeon and a BAPEN member? If so you are also a member of BAPEN Medical? BAPEN Medical are a core group of BAPEN which is primarily aimed at doctors with an interest in clinical nutrition.

items.title: DSU/DSI: Filter use when administering parenteral nutrition
items.summary: Device Safety Information – https://www.gov.uk/drug-device-alerts/filters-should-be-used-during-the-administration-of-parenteral-nutrition-for-patients-in-all-care-settings-dsi-slash-2026-slash-011 Drug Safety Update…

items.title: The MHRA have just published a Field Safety Notice
items.summary: Safety Notice Filters should be used during the administration of Parenteral Nutrition for patients in all care settings DSI/2026/011 – GOV.UK To Note: Patients having Home parenteral support will have a filter as standard as part of their care.

items.title: Filters should be used when administering parenteral nutrition, MHRA states
items.summary: Advice has been issued to care home staff and other healthcare professionals about the need to use a filter when administering parenteral nutrition following ‘a number of adverse incidents’.

items.title: Filters should be used during the administration of Parenteral Nutrition for patients in all care settings DSI/2026/011
items.summary: Administration of parenteral nutrition without a filter has been associated with a number of adverse incidents including an embolism which resulted in a fatal outcome.

items.title: Get ready for UK Malnutrition Awareness Week 2026
items.summary: BAPEN is delighted to be partnering once again with the Malnutrition Task Force (MTF) for UK Malnutrition Awareness Week (UKMAW) 2026, taking place from 16th – 22nd November 2026.

items.title: BAPEN Student Representative Positions Now Open for Applications
items.summary: BAPEN has opened applications for student representative positions across a multitude of BAPEN committees and groups.
